title: MultiSWAP MODFLOW6 Cell Response — Canonical Admission
scientific_decision: Each tile response is treated as a local affine law q_i(H)=q_i*+(u_i/dt_s)(H-H_i*).
Tile responses are reconciled to one explicit common reference head before aggregation.
Cell coupling storage is u_cell=sum(f_i u_i), giving dq_cell/dH=u_cell/dt_s.
The raw area-weighted predictor q_u is diagnostic only when tile predictor terminal heads differ.
Reduction is deterministic in ascending tile-id order with compensated summation and full provenance checks.
